name: Socket MCP
summary: Socket's MCP server for dependency security scores (depscore) plus organization, alert and threat-feed tools; hosted at mcp.socket.dev with Socket OAuth, or self-hosted npm package. MIT.
description: Repository SocketDev/socket-mcp (MIT per README and GitHub, not archived; npm @socketsecurity/mcp; README says 'early development and rapidly evolving'). Lets assistants score a package, audit a package.json or find risky dependencies; tools named in the README are depscore, organizations, alerts and threat_feed, covering ecosystems such as npm, PyPI, cargo, Maven, NuGet, RubyGems and Go. Hosted server: https://mcp.socket.dev/ (Streamable HTTP). README: sign-in through your MCP client's OAuth flow is required for every tool call, including package scoring; no API key to copy. Probe 2026-11-28 (unauthenticated, no tool calls): GET returned HTTP 405 (JSON); POST initialize returned HTTP 200 as text/event-stream with protocolVersion 2025-06-18, serverInfo name 'socket' version 0.4.0 and a tools capability; tools/list was answered without sign-in and included depscore (calling tools needs OAuth per the README). OAuth behaviour varies by client: the README's tested-clients table says Claude Code needed an explicit authenticate step, Codex may show an invalid_scope page before retrying, and only `organizations` and `depscore` were tested. Self-hosting: stdio uses a saved browser OAuth session (a SOCKET_API_TOKEN env var is a discouraged fallback); HTTP mode can report server errors to Sentry only if SOCKET_MCP_SENTRY_DSN is set, and stdio never reports. Pricing: the README states no MCP-specific fee; a Socket account is required and Socket's plans (socket.dev/pricing, 2026-11-28: Free $0 per dev seat with 1,000 scans/month, Team $25, Business $50, Enterprise custom) apply to usage. Documented installs and OAuth sign-in were not run; no Socket account was created.

agent_access.notes: Hosted Streamable HTTP; per README every tool call needs Socket OAuth. Probe 2026-11-28: bare GET 405; unauthenticated initialize 200 (serverInfo socket 0.4.0); unauthenticated tools/list listed depscore. No tool was called, no sign-in done. Self-host via npm; optional Sentry in HTTP mode only.
